title: TINITALY 10 m DEM bootstrap and Unreal heightmap preparation
hypothesis: A licensed 10 m TINITALY DEM can provide a deterministic real-world macro-terrain baseline for the Passo Giau spike.
technical: Remote acquisition and deterministic preparation passed.
800 x 800 at 10 m was prepared as a 1009 x 1009 Unreal Landscape candidate.
Source provenance and conversion parameters were recorded.
visual: Useful as a real-terrain bootstrap, but not retained as the best available source once the Veneto 5 m DTM was validated.
reject: TINITALY 10 m as the preferred foreground Landscape source for the current Passo Giau rider-visible spike.
learnings: A technically valid terrain source can be superseded when a materially better licensed source becomes available.
next: Evaluate the official Regione del Veneto 5 m LiDAR-derived DTM on the same AOI.
